firstPlayerRule: The player with the oldest penny goes first. The rules also explicitly allow the group to choose who starts by any method they prefer.
clarifications: Starting with the chosen player and continuing clockwise, each player contracts one miner during setup.
Once all players have a miner, the same starting player takes the first regular turn; play then continues clockwise.

internalEvidence: CMX Games' Copper Country page https://www.cmxgames.com/copper-country/ embeds a Google Drive rulebook download for BGG identity 147206. The publisher-linked English PDF was retrieved after its authorized Googleusercontent redirect. Printed/PDF pages 5–6 were rendered and visually checked. Page 5 names the oldest penny and expressly allows any other selection method; page 6 confirms the first normal turn. Publisher-linked PDF SHA-256: f5bb705934303025f3246fac0fd4a500a9f14c37fa1657bb088c05afbae9e4bb. Owner-authorized Codex editorial review, 2026-09-25.
uncertainty: The oldest-penny method gives no tie-break; the official any-method alternative lets groups resolve an unavailable or tied penny.
